qa_pairs.question: Under what conditions does fuse 19 receive power?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 19 is hot in run only from unloader relay K7.

qa_pairs.question: What connector designation is shown for the accessory connector?
qa_pairs.answer: The accessory connector is designated as C302.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color connects to the rear defogger switch at position 4?
qa_pairs.answer: A 2.5 GN/BU (green/blue) wire connects to position 4 of the rear defogger switch.

qa_pairs.question: Which component is referenced on page 5210-0?
qa_pairs.answer: The instrument cluster is referenced on page 5210-0.

qa_pairs.question: What is the wire color designation for the connection to position 13 of the instrument cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: The wire connecting to position 13 of the instrument cluster is .5 VI/NT (violet/natural).

qa_pairs.question: What components receive power through the .75 GN/WT wire?
qa_pairs.answer: The .75 GN/WT (green/white) wire provides power to multiple components including connections at C405 and S501.

qa_pairs.question: Under what operating condition is fuse 12 energized?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 12 is hot in accessory, run, or start positions.

qa_pairs.question: What is the reference page for the mirror control switch?
qa_pairs.answer: The mirror control switch is referenced on page 5116-0.
